$comment: Ceilings for `npm run perf:budget` (size: bytes / counts) and `npm run perf` (scenario medians: ms / MB / s / %), set to the v0.1.11 baseline (YAZ-2073 1A/1B; the measured runs are in baseline.json). THE RATCHET (🔒 D17): a change that improves a metric lowers its ceiling here in the same PR; raising one needs Yasin's OK in the PR description. `target` is the YAZ-2073 goal. The tolerances absorb build-to-build byte jitter and run-to-run timing noise, nothing more.
